purpose: Scope resume: look up the next sidecar seq offset for a resumed run
misreport_risk: none: a wrong offset only mislabels tool-call attribution; fail-open to 0

purpose: clearSidecar: empty both sidecar files after the run
misreport_risk: none: failure only leaves later tool calls misattributed (already a logged warning)

purpose: Scope resume branch: write the sidecar before the scoper agent runs
misreport_risk: none: fail-open

purpose: Scope-agent-failed fallback: wall-clock timestamp for the fallback records
misreport_risk: none: use args.start_ts (a fallback timestamp need not be exact)

purpose: Scope-agent-failed fallback: write a failed event record
misreport_risk: none: monitoring write failure must never fail the workflow (CLAUDE.md Hard Rule)

purpose: Scope-agent-failed fallback: write the run record
misreport_risk: none: same Hard Rule

purpose: Detect a concurrent session claiming the same ticket (writes a record)
misreport_risk: none: advisory and fail-open

purpose: Generate the execution id (time + random suffix)
misreport_risk: none: supply `args.execution_id`; the script cannot call Date.now()/Math.random() natively

purpose: writeSidecar: write the per-agent-call sidecar (13 invocations per run)
misreport_risk: low, but a cost multiplier: 13 extra agent dispatches per run. See follow-up on batching

purpose: captureTs: per-phase wall-clock timestamp (11 invocations per run)
misreport_risk: low: only `args.start_ts` is exact; per-phase `ts` can be stamped by the writeMonitoring agent (it already runs `date`) or dropped; 11 extra dispatches otherwise

purpose: captureEpochMs: workflow-start epoch ms for the shadow reviewer's wall-time field
misreport_risk: none: shadow path only; omit natively

purpose: Move or copy the scoped ticket into tickets/inprogress/ (mutates a tracked path)
feeds: where the rest of the run reads the ticket from
misreport_risk: low: if an agent reported a move that did not happen, done-checker's `ticket_location` and Finalize's migration check fail loudly later

purpose: Classify a done-checker `frontmatter_valid` FAIL as unregistered-tag vs other
misreport_risk: medium-low: a misreport swaps one blocking status for another; neither lets the ticket close

purpose: Scope: verify every tag on the scoped ticket is in the tag registry
feeds: returns TAGS_NOT_REGISTERED and stops the run
misreport_risk: a fabricated `[]` lets an unregistered tag through; `done-checker`'s `frontmatter_valid` still catches it at Verify (defence in depth), so impact is delay not escape

purpose: Shadow context-packet assembly (env-flagged, empty candidate set)
misreport_risk: none: shadow path, `timeout 10s ... || true`

purpose: Plan gate: does plan.md still contain an Unresolved Questions heading
misreport_risk: a fabricated `false` lets a plan with open questions proceed to Implement; later gates do not re-check it

purpose: Doc-staleness gate: behavior change without a docs/ update
misreport_risk: a fabricated PASS lets an undocumented behavior change through; done-checker's `docs_to_update_coverage` is a partial backstop

purpose: Read the ticket's Files Changed section to warn about omitted docs
misreport_risk: none: warn-only

purpose: Static architecture checks whose results are handed to the architecture-reviewer agent
feeds: input to an agent's verdict (the agent's verdict gates, and an unparseable result is shown to it as UNPARSEABLE)
misreport_risk: low: failure is visible to the agent; the agent's own verdict remains the gate

purpose: Shadow reviewer window check for architecture-verify
misreport_risk: none: shadow path, fail-open

purpose: Write the shadow reviewer event for architecture-verify
misreport_risk: none: shadow path, `timeout 15s ... || true`

purpose: Compute the test directories implied by files_changed
feeds: input to the Test agent's prompt and to the test-scope gate below
misreport_risk: low: the gate below recomputes against the actual pytest command

purpose: Test-scope gate: does the pytest command cover every implicated test directory
misreport_risk: a fabricated PASS accepts an under-scoped test run, a false pass of the Test phase

purpose: Post-Test cleanup of data/runs and reports/release_proof (deletes files) and verify
misreport_risk: a fabricated CLEANED leaves stale artifacts; done-checker's `data_runs_clean` is the backstop

purpose: Parity: does files_changed intersect a P0 parity entry (forces a full parity run)
feeds: branch: skip or run the parity-updater
misreport_risk: a fabricated no-intersection skips a parity update that a P0 entry required; the strongest silent-skip risk of the control sites

purpose: Parity: expected parity subsystems for the changed files
feeds: input to the parity-updater agent and the next-id lookup
misreport_risk: low: visible hint to the agent

purpose: Parity: next free ledger id per shard
misreport_risk: low: a hint, not a gate

purpose: Parity: which ledger files the parity-updater touched
feeds: input to the cross-reference gate below
misreport_risk: feeds a gate: a fabricated empty list turns the gate below into a pass

purpose: Parity gate: did the updater touch the expected ledger shards
misreport_risk: a fabricated PASS accepts an incomplete parity update

purpose: Shadow reviewer window check for security-review
misreport_risk: none: shadow path, fail-open

purpose: Write the shadow reviewer event for security-review
misreport_risk: none: shadow path, `timeout 15s ... || true`

purpose: Finalize self-check: migration, ticket location, one working_log row, REGISTRY regenerated (mutates docs/REGISTRY.yaml)
feeds: returns FINALIZE_INCOMPLETE; otherwise the run reports DONE
misreport_risk: the highest-consequence site: a fabricated all-PASS lets a ticket be reported DONE without being finalized. Needs attestation or an independent second check

purpose: Did docs/ change during this run (decides whether to reindex)
feeds: branch: run the reindex or not
misreport_risk: none: a wrong answer only skips or adds a search-index refresh

purpose: Refresh the docs search index after a run that changed docs/
feeds: a WARNING log line on failure
misreport_risk: none: fail-open by design

purpose: Verify the monitoring write landed
feeds: a loud warning in the return message, never a status change
misreport_risk: none: advisory by design (CLAUDE.md Hard Rule)

purpose: Advisory tag-relevance drift check
misreport_risk: none: advisory

purpose: Advisory phase-meta conformance check
feeds: a `failed` event and a warning, status stays DONE
misreport_risk: none: advisory

purpose: Advisory mechanism-registry changed-code check
misreport_risk: none: advisory
